# Descriptions
@@ 1
Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Water condenses
gradually into the caster’s hands and may be funneled into any suitable
receptacle.
@@ 2
Warms 1 cubic foot per level of air (any inanimate gas) up to 100°F above
normal.
@@ 3
Creates dense fog in a 10' radius; normal visibility is 1'. See Section 15.12
(p. 98).
@@ 4
Creates a 10'x10'x3' wall of dense churning air: cuts all movement and attacks
through it by 50% (i.e., -50 to attacks).
@@ 5
Stops generalized air movement (e.g., wind) up to winds of 30 mph and cuts
higher winds by 30 mph in a 10' radius.
@@ 6
Creates a 5' radius near vacuum, all in radius take an 'A' Impact critical, as
air leaves and rushes back in.
@@ 7
As Fog I, except radius is 50'.
@@ 8
All fog is dissipated in a 50' radius.
@@ 9
As Airwall, except wall is 10'x20'x3' and can be curved up to a semicircle.
@@ 10
As Airwall, but has a set duration of 1 minute per level and doesn’t require
concentration.
@@ 11
As Fog I, except radius is 100'.
@@ 12
As Airstop I, except radius is 50'.
@@ 13
As Unfog V, except radius is 100'.
@@ 14
As Vacuum I, except radius is 10'.
@@ 15
All gas within 10' radius of caster is converted to breathable air.
@@ 17
Creates a whirlwind about caster; it moves with the caster and has a 10'
radius. No missile attacks can penetrate it and any movement or melee (except
for caster’s) into or through it is cut by 80%.
@@ 18
As Vacuum I, except radius is 20'.
@@ 20
Creates a 50' radius of high oxygen content air; all within receive a 20 bonus
to their OBs and fire attacks deliver double damage.
@@ 25
As Fog I, except duration is 1 hour per level and radius is 100' per level.
@@ 30
As Unfog, except radius is 100' per level.
@@ 50
Caster has complete control of clouds within area of effect (includes fog); he
can control storm clouds and cause them to rain, but he can’t create them.
